referenceFunction.generalComment: LCI of CHEOPS perovskite silicon tandem modules to be produced by OXPV in Germany. LCI published in de Wild-Scholten, M. 2017: Deliverable 3.1 Life Cycle Analysis of CHEOPS technologies and benchmarking: Screening. Published LCI embeddeed in UVEK LCI data DQRv2:2018.
